title: JELL-O™ X TOWER 28 Lip Jelly Lip Gloss Gift Set
descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ Vegan✓ Clean at Sephora✓ High Shine Finish✓ Gluten Free
What it is: A limited-edition JELL-O® x Tower 28 gift set featuring two full-size ShineOn Lip Jellies in juicy, exclusive scents: Strawberry and Lemon-Lime.

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Apricot Kernel Oil: Nurtures and soothes lips.
- Raspberry Seed Oil: Protects lips against damage from free radicals and environmental aggressors.
- Rosehip Oil: Contains vitamins A and E while promoting cell repair and regeneration.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. These products are also vegan, gluten-free, and cru
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Swipe onto bare lips for juicy, jelly shine, or layer over your favorite lip color.
Ingredients+
-Apricot Kernel Oil: Nurtures and soothes lips.
-Raspberry Seed Oil: Protects lips against damage from free radicals and environmental aggressors.
-Rosehip Oil: Contains vitamins A and E while promoting cell repair and regeneration.

ShineOn Lip Jelly Lemon Lime:
Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Polybutene, Prunus Armeniaca (Apricot) Kernel Oil, Ethylene/Propylene/Styrene Copolymer, Octyldodecanol, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Extract, Flavor (Aroma), Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Extract, Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Oil, Rosa Canina Seed Oil, Rubus Idaeus (Raspberry) Seed Oil, Butylene/Ethylene/Styrene Copolymer, Citral, Tocopherol, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-di-t-butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Limonene, Linalool, Geraniol, FD&C Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140), FD&C Blue 1 Lake (CI 42090).

ShineOn Lip Jelly Strawberry:
Polybutene,Hydrogenated Polyisobutene,Octyldodecanol,Prunus Armeniaca (Apricot) Kernel Oil,Ethylene/Propylene/Styrene Copolymer,Silica Dimethyl Silylate,Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Extract,Flavor (Aroma),Caprylyl Glycol,Ethylhexylglycerin,Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Extract,Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Oil,Rosa Canina Seed Oil,Rubus Idaeus (Raspberry) Seed Oil,Butylene/Ethylene/Styrene Copolymer,Tocopherol,Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract,Pentaerythrityl Tetra-di-t-butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate,Limonene,Linalool,D&C Red 27 (CI 45410),FD&C Red 40 Lake (CI 16035).
